parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel of the cabinet made of MDF, typically with a wood veneer finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the cabinet while providing an aesthetic front surface.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A middle door panel of the cabinet made of MDF, similar to the other doors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the middle storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A top door panel of the cabinet made of MDF, matching the other doors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf panel inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the storage space and supports items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A mid-upper shelf panel inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf panel inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A topmost shelf panel inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the uppermost storage surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.
